name: @devel-solid/agentscli
description: Install skills for authoring and refactoring conventions and generating a project AGENTS.md index.

scripts.dogfood: pnpm run build && node dist/cli.js init --repo-root . && node .agents/skills/agentscli-build-agents/scripts/build-agents.mjs sync --repo-root .
scripts.format: prettier --write src assets/templates/skills scripts tests/unit package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json .agentscli/conventions README.md CONTRIBUTING.md "docs/**/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml" ".agents/skills/agentscli-publish-package/**/*"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src assets/templates/skills scripts tests/unit package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json .agentscli/conventions README.md CONTRIBUTING.md "docs/**/*.md" ".github/workflows/*.yml" ".agents/skills/agentscli-publish-package/**/*"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && pnpm test && pnpm run check:resources
